name: Git Clone Allowed
description: Clone an approved GitHub repository into a bounded relative destination path.

steps.description: Clone the repository into the approved destination

constraints: Only GitHub clone URLs are allowed
Destination stays inside the approved relative workspace scope
Clone depth is fixed to 1 for a narrow initial checkout
invariants: No arbitrary git flags or alternate protocols are allowed
No destination path traversal is possible
The recipe only performs clone, not push or history mutation
